connector.consent_unverified_help: The app chose this name itself. Check that the address it returns to, below, is one you expect.
connector.consent_read_performance: Performance, dividends, fees and risk figures
connector.consent_read_memory: Your investor profile and what you asked the assistant to remember
connector.consent_read_market: Quotes, company data and earnings dates
connector.consent_write_help: Add, correct and delete transactions, mark transfers, and change your watchlist, alerts, memory and settings. It shows you each change to your transactions before applying it, and every one can be undone.
connector.consent_cannot: Leave the box empty and it can only read. Either way it cannot wipe your book or delete your account, and it never sees your Google sign-in.
connector.consent_return: After you answer, you go back to:
connector.consent_revoke_hint: You can disconnect it at any time from Profile.
connector.consent_expired: The request has expired. Go back to the app you were connecting and start again.
connector.consent_unknown_client: That app is no longer registered. Go back to it and connect again.
connector.consent_stale_form: This page is out of date. Go back to the app you were connecting and start again.
